WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT o."observstation", o."weathprofile",
         AVG(t."bandusagepct") AS avg_bandusagepct,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM "telescopes" AS t
  INNER JOIN "observatories" AS o
    ON t."observstation" = o."observstation"
  WHERE t."pointaccarc" > 4.86
  GROUP BY o."observstation", o."weathprofile"
)
SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_group_bandusagepct,
       AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_group_telescope_count
FROM grouped;
